correctness.rationale: Vertex-orbit classification under the 3-cycle has constant words C_a, two-equal words D_ab and three-distinct inadmissible orbits (internal Hamming distance 3). C_a and D_ab join only for c=a or c=b, while distinct D_ab and D_cd join only for a=c. Therefore the exact orbit complex consists of q disjoint full simplices connected by q(q-1) cross-edges and no cross-triangles. Equivariantly contract each simplex to its distinguished vertex; the resulting directed multigraph has q vertices and q(q-1) distinct geometric edges, so first Betti number (q-1)^2 and no higher homology. Boundary image is integral augmentation U_q; trace on oriented edge permutation module is f(f-1), and trace on U_q is f-1, giving (f-1)^2. Independent word-orbit compatibility enumerations for q=3..7 corroborated graph ranks 4,9,16,25,36; all-q follows by exhaustive orbit-type proof.
